prompt: A team creates a 1 GB paid Redis Cloud Essentials plan with replication enabled. How much of that plan can the dataset itself use?
explanation: On Redis Cloud Essentials the plan size includes replication: replication requires a memory limit that is double the dataset size, so a 1 GB plan allocates 512 MB to the dataset and 512 MB to the replica. Pro databases work the other way around: you select the dataset size and Redis Cloud calculates the memory limit from your replication settings.

options.text: 1 GB, because replication memory comes from spare capacity outside the plan
About 750 MB, because replication needs roughly a quarter of the plan
2 GB, because enabling replication doubles the usable dataset space
